manufacturer: DEMONSTRATION PROFILE - not a commercial product
validationStatus: UNVALIDATED DEMONSTRATION PROFILE. Exists to exercise the timed reaction-fingerprint path. Offsets, thresholds and colour regions are illustrative and are NOT derived from characterised samples.

referenceCard.description: Eight-patch reference card: a four-step neutral grey ramp plus four saturated primaries. The grey ramp constrains the exposure and tone terms of the fit; the primaries constrain the channel-mixing terms.
referenceCard.printNotes: Print on matte stock at 100% scale. Glossy paper produces specular highlights that the glare gate will reject. Verify printed patches against the sRGB values in this profile before field use; an uncharacterised card makes every measurement taken with it uncharacterised.

reactionWindow.observationNotes: Offsets are measured from reagent contact. These values are illustrative; a real kit's offsets come from its manufacturer's stated development window.

captureInstructions: Perform the physical field test exactly as the kit manufacturer specifies.
Place the DS-CARD-A reference card in the same plane and light as the reaction area.
Start the timed sequence at reagent contact.
Keep the phone in the same position for the whole sequence: moving it between frames changes the illumination and corrupts the trajectory.
The app captures at 0, 3, 6, 9, 12 and 15 seconds.
safetyNotes: Follow the kit manufacturer's handling, PPE and disposal instructions in full.
A presumptive result never substitutes for confirmatory laboratory analysis.
